capabilities: Map individual vault folders to folders on multiple cloud drives
Sync folders with Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, and Notion using 3-way snapshots
Preview changes with a dry run before syncing
Migrate content between drives by drag and drop
Protect changes with sync confirmation and trash bins on both sides
extras: Freemium: unlimited drives, real-time sync, and smart content merge are paid Pro features. Notion sync is experimental and the README warns it may corrupt or delete content; complex Notion blocks and databases are not fully supported. The README notes the plugin was developed with AI-assisted programming and warns users to keep offline backups.
motivation: The author built it to manage their cloud drives from Obsidian, saying it 'greatly reduced duplication and orphaned content' in their drives.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync selected vault folders to multiple personal cloud drives or migrate content between them.
